tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a damped fast transient, but the late-horizon rows leave the underlying dynamics and input effects ambiguous. A fine trajectory can distinguish the candidate temporal mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed y/u_now ratios do not follow the monotonic horizon dependence of the stated one-state law.
Five late-horizon observations with correlated inputs cannot reliably identify the transient and slow components.
It does not resolve the temporal mechanism.
